name: melodiespark-template
description: The assembled reference layout: CATALOG, SOURCE, DOCS, TESTS, WEB3, ARCHITECTURE, PUBLISHING.

variables.DESCRIPTION: Melodiespark reference template with a full content catalog and safe extraction defaults.

notes: Emits the reference directory layout: 8 files, each section seeded with a README stating what belongs there and how it is populated.

CATALOG ships with its README only, NOT with a catalog snapshot. Seeding a 4.5 MB snapshot would put a copy that is stale the instant the source tree changes into every generated project and into the npm tarball. Populate it deliberately: melodie catalog --build --out ./CATALOG
SOURCE is intentionally EMPTY. Content is never copied into a template by default. Populate it only with `melodie extract`, which is deny-by-default and writes an audit trail.
WEB3/README.md points at the consent-gated `web3` template. This layout does not contain wallet code.
